Order management service for Meridian Retail (team Checkout). It places, lists, reads and cancels customer orders and publishes `OrderPlaced` and `OrderCancelled` events.

## Commands
- `npm run build` compiles `src/` and `test/` to `dist/`.

- `npm run typecheck` type-checks without emitting.

`createApp(deps?)` in `src/main.ts` is the entry point for integration tests and the one the unit tests use. Keep it working.

const app = createApp({ eventPublisher, clock, idGenerator, paymentGateway });

+import { StockUnavailableError } from "../core/errors.js";
+import type { StockGateway } from "../core/ports.js";
+
+const STOCK_BASE_URL = "https://stock.inventory.internal";
+const STOCK_PATH = "/v1/stock/";
+
+type FetchFunction = (input: string, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>;
+
+export interface HttpStockGatewayOptions {
+  readonly baseUrl?: string;
+  readonly timeoutMs?: number;
+  /** Replaces the global `fetch`; used by tests so that no network is involved. */
+  readonly fetchFunction?: FetchFunction;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Client of the inventory team's Stock API:
+ * GET {base}/v1/stock/{sku} -> { "sku": string, "available": number }.
+ */
+export class HttpStockGateway implements StockGateway {
+  private readonly baseUrl: string;
+  private readonly timeoutMs: number;
+  private readonly fetchFunction: FetchFunction | undefined;
+
+  constructor(options: HttpStockGatewayOptions = {}) {
+    this.baseUrl = options.baseUrl ?? STOCK_BASE_URL;
+    this.timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? 3_000;
+    this.fetchFunction = options.fetchFunction;
+  }
+
+  async available(sku: string): Promise<number> {
+    const send = this.fetchFunction ?? globalThis.fetch;
+    let response: Response;
+    try {
+      response = await send(`${this.baseUrl}${STOCK_PATH}${encodeURIComponent(sku)}`, {
+        method: "GET",
+        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(this.timeoutMs),
+      });
+    } catch (cause) {
+      throw new StockUnavailableError("Stock API request failed", { cause });
+    }
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      throw new StockUnavailableError(`Stock API answered ${response.status}`);
+    }
+    let body: unknown;
+    try {
+      body = await response.json();
+    } catch (cause) {
+      throw new StockUnavailableError("Stock API answered with invalid JSON", { cause });
+    }
+    const available = (body as { available?: unknown } | null)?.available;
+    if (typeof available !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(available)) {
+      throw new StockUnavailableError("Stock API answered without an availability");
+    }
+    return available;
+  }
+}
